target_groups.description: Person or group from a specific protected identity that is considered a potential target of hate speech.

dominance.description: Whether the definition allows dominant groups to be targets of hate speech.

dominant_groups.description: Dominant groups that the definition explicitly mentions as potential targets.

explicit_reference.description: Presence of an explicit reference to the target group, related to the target(s) above.

incites.description: Potential effects or consequences of the utterance that the definition treats as constitutive of hate speech.

insults_group.description: Whether the definition insults a group.
